parameters.query: select f.finding_id, f.agent, f.risk, f.title, f.finding_condition, f.recommendation, f.run_id, f.created_at from fia.findings f where not exists (select 1 from fia.finding_deliveries d where d.finding_id = f.finding_id and d.channel = 'discord') order by f.created_at limit 25
insert into fia.finding_deliveries (finding_id, channel) values ($1::uuid, 'discord') on conflict do nothing

select f.finding_id, f.agent, f.risk, f.title, f.finding_condition, f.recommendation, f.run_id, f.created_at from fia.findings f where not exists (select 1 from fia.finding_deliveries d where d.finding_id = f.finding_id and d.channel = 'email') order by f.created_at limit 25
insert into fia.finding_deliveries (finding_id, channel) select unnest(string_to_array($1, '|'))::uuid, 'email' on conflict do nothing
